name_en: Gomoku Inarizushi — fried tofu pouches filled with mixed vegetable rice, from Kasama
summary_ja: 油揚げに、人参やごぼう、しいたけを混ぜ込んだ酢飯を詰めたいなりずし。笠間稲荷神社の門前町・笠間市では、そばやくるみも加えた華やかな具で古くから参詣客をもてなしてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: Fried tofu pockets are stuffed with vinegared rice mixed with carrot, burdock, and shiitake. In Kasama, home to Kasama Inari Shrine, the mix grows even more colorful with local soba and walnuts, served to shrine visitors.
source_title: 五目いなりずし 茨城県
